about: WastePlanner's legal documents: the ONE place their versions and effective dates live. The text is legal/terms.md and legal/privacy.md (file names are relative to this file); terms.html / privacy.html render it and the app reads the versions from here for sign-up and acceptance. Change a document = edit its .md and its version/effective here, in one commit. publishedAt: accounts created on or after this day that never ticked the sign-up box are asked to accept at once (null = held: nobody is asked, decided 2026-10-20 until the lawyer has reviewed v2.0). reacceptFrom: the day existing users must accept the current versions (set to 30 days after the notice email; null = not yet). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, Australia/Melbourne.
